mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month preceding the prediction triggers a term premium compression effect, reducing the present value of future equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the month prior to prediction
regime_hint: early stage of a tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically significantly negative (p > 0.05) during confirmed tightening episodes, or term premium compression is not measurable via SPX discount rates.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 215 over two consecutive months indicate deflationary pressure, which lowers real discount rates and increases expected equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls two consecutive months below 215
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during confirmed deflation episodes, or CPIAUCSL recovers without a sustained decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in employment growth (PAYEMS) above 150,000 jobs in a month is accompanied by rising consumer confidence (indirectly via HOUST), creating dual demand-side signals that push S&P 500 forward returns positive within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 150,000 in a single month and HOUST rises in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when employment and confidence move in opposite directions, or during periods of data revision.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 signals supply-side weakness that persists for two consecutive months, lowering growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls two consecutive months below 105
regime_hint: supply shock or soft landing risk
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) during confirmed supply contractions, or SPX outperforms sector indices.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (implied via HOUST) exceed 850 for two consecutive months, it reflects resilient consumer demand that supports optimism about future earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above 850 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when retail sales remain flat or decline, or during periods of data revision.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.5% for three consecutive months, without a corresponding rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL), signals a strong labor market that the Fed is unlikely to aggressively tighten, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% for three consecutive months and CPIAUCSL does not exceed 215 over the same period
regime_hint: labor market strength with stable inflation
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) when unemployment remains low but inflation spikes, or Fed hikes rates unexpectedly.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in job openings (RSAFS) below 7.5 million accompanied by rising wage growth (implied via UNRATE > 6.0%) indicates tight labor markets that can cause inflationary pressures and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below 7.5 million and UNRATE rises above 6.0% in the same month
regime_hint: labor market tightness with wage pressures
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when job openings rise while unemployment falls, or wage growth decelerates.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102, followed by a sustained rise to above 108, signals a supply recovery that reduces growth uncertainty and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 102 for three consecutive months then crosses above 108 in the fourth month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO recovers but underlying sector indicators (e.g., manufacturing PMI) remain weak.
